# Better Beds — New Takeoff Inventory, Dallas

> Better Beds sells new takeoff truck beds and parts, plus selected used beds, from current inventory. Each listing states its condition. Select older inventory beds can be repaired and painted by arrangement. New takeoff inventory is the main business focus.

Contact: 214-524-8401 (call/text), clint@betterbeds.pro.
Pickup: 3123 Cartwright Street, Dallas, TX 75212. Monday–Saturday 9 AM–5 PM Central. Confirm stock and pickup before traveling.
Installation and removal are not offered. Forklift loading is available for purchased beds, for transport only.

Inventory categories: Beds, Lights, Tailgates and Bumpers. Takeoff beds focus on Ford F-250/F-350 and Ram, Chevy and GMC 2500/3500 series. Bed listings include the exact length and style name. Refer to current listings for confirmed stock.

- [Inventory](https://betterbeds.pro/inventory.html): Current listings; confirm exact fitment, availability, condition and included parts.
- [Inventory data](https://betterbeds.pro/data/inventory.json): Listing data. Do not infer quantities, holds, accessories or additional stock.
- [How to buy](https://betterbeds.pro/process.html): Confirm details and arrange payment and pickup.
- [Older inventory](https://betterbeds.pro/older-beds.html): Limited existing beds prepared by arrangement.
- [Inventory inquiry](https://betterbeds.pro/quote.html): Send an inquiry with optional truck photos. An inquiry does not reserve stock.
- [FAQs](https://betterbeds.pro/faq.html): Takeoffs, fitment, included parts, pickup and payment.
- [Contact](https://betterbeds.pro/contact.html): Phone/text, email and Dallas pickup details.
